units.source_text: 左马头发表议论说：“无论何等升官发财，本来门第并不高贵，世人对他们的期望总是两样的。

en.t: The Captain of the Left Stables offered his opinion: "No matter how high someone rises in office or wealth, if his family was not originally noble, people will always expect something different from him.

units.source_text: 还有，从前门第高贵，但是现在家道衰微，经济困难了；加之时势移变，人望衰落了，心中虽然还是好高，但是事与愿违，有时会做出不体面的事来。

en.t: Then there are those whose families were once noble, but whose houses have now declined and whose finances have grown difficult; as times change and their reputation fades, they may still be proud at heart, yet circumstances go against their wishes, and at times they do unbecoming things.

units.source_text: 像这两种人，各有各的原因，都应该评定为中等。

en.t: People of these two kinds each have their own reasons, and both should be ranked as middle class.

units.source_text: 还有一种人，身为诸国长官[\[5\]](#part1331.html#m5)，掌握地方行政，其等级已经确定。

en.t: There is another kind of person: one who serves as governor of a province[\[5\]](#part1331.html#m5), controls local administration, and whose rank has already been fixed.

units.source_text: 但其中又有上中下之别，选拔其中等的女子，正是现时的好尚。

en.t: But even among them there are upper, middle, and lower grades, and choosing a woman from the middle of that group is precisely the present fashion.

units.source_text: 还有一种人，地位不及公卿，也没有当过与公卿同列的宰相，只是有四位的爵位。

en.t: There is still another kind: a man whose position does not reach that of the court nobles, who has never served as a councillor ranking with them, and who merely holds a fourth-rank title.

units.source_text: 然而世间的声望并不坏，本来的出身也不贱，自由自在地过着安乐的日子。

en.t: Yet his reputation in the world is not bad, his original birth is not low, and he lives a comfortable life in freedom and ease.
That is truly something to be pleased about.

units.source_text: 这种家庭经济充足，尽可自由挥霍，不须节约；

en.t: Such a household has ample means, can spend freely as it likes, and has no need to economize;

units.source_text: 教养女儿，更是郑重其事，关怀无微不至。

en.t: and when raising a daughter, it treats the matter with even greater seriousness and attends to her with the utmost care.

units.source_text: 这样成长起来的女子之中，有不少才貌双全的美人呢！

en.t: Among women brought up in this way, there are many beauties endowed with both talent and looks!

units.source_text: 此种女子一旦入宫，侥幸获得恩宠，便享莫大幸福，其例不胜枚举。”

en.t: Once such a woman enters the palace and is fortunate enough to win favor, she enjoys immense happiness; examples are too numerous to count."
